title: OAuth2 and JWT
description: Implement OAuth2 flows and JWT authentication.

data.text: OAuth2 is an authorization framework. JWT (JSON Web Token) is a compact token format. Together they power authentication in microservices.

terms.definition: An authorization framework for delegated access.
A token used to access protected resources.
A token used to obtain new access tokens.

data.text: A JWT has three parts: header (algorithm), payload (claims), and signature. It is compact and self-contained.

items: sub (subject): who the token is about
iat (issued at): when it was issued

data.caption: OAuth2 + JWT Flow
data.definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant App as App
    participant Auth as Auth Server
    participant API as API
    U->>App: Login
    App->>Auth: Authorization Code
    Auth-->>U: Consent
    App->>Auth: Exchange Code
    Auth-->>App: Access Token (JWT)
    App->>API: Request (Bearer JWT)
    API->>API: Validate JWT
    API-->>App: Response

data.title: JWT Validation in Node.js
Key Takeaways
points: JWT is a compact token format
data.takeaway: OAuth2 and JWT power microservices authentication.
